summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and its tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. Tests pass: 42 passed across the new SHACL tests and the existing test/test_path.py, run with the prepared venv. Nothing committed. Choices: added an explicit Node isinstance guard so non-node inputs like None do not trigger wildcard graph lookups; formatting was done by hand because black and isort are not in the venv, so the repo formatter and linters still need a run.
